title: Cinnamon Oat Breakfast Bowl
description: A warm, simple breakfast bowl with oats, cinnamon, and fruit.
instructions: Warm the oats and milk together in a saucepan until creamy.
Stir in the cinnamon and maple syrup.
Top with berries and serve immediately.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken Tray Bake
description: A bright sheet-pan dinner with chicken, potatoes, and vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the vegetables and chicken with oil, lemon, and seasoning.
Spread on a tray and roast for 30 to 35 minutes until cooked through.

title: No-Bake Peanut Butter Bars
description: Easy bars with a rich peanut butter filling and crunchy crust.
instructions: Mix the cracker crumbs with melted butter and press into a pan.
Warm the peanut butter and honey together until smooth.
Spread over the crust and chill.
Melt the chocolate chips and drizzle over the top before slicing.
